```verilog
module binary_counter(
  input clk,
  input [3:0] reset,
  input [3:0] enable,
  output reg [3:0] count
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
  if (reset == 4'b1111) begin
    count <= 4'b0000;
  end else if (enable == 4'b1111) begin
    count <= count + 1;
    if (count == 4'b1111) begin
      count <= 4'b0000;
    end
  end
end

endmodule
```

```verilog
    input clk,
    input reset,
    input load,
    input enable,
    input [3:0] data_in,
    output reg [3:0] out
);

wire comp_out;

comparator compare_unit (
    .in1(data_in),
    .in2(out),
    .out(comp_out)
);

    if (reset) begin
        out <= 4'b0;
    end else if (load) begin
        out <= data_in;
    end else if (enable) begin
```
